Chapter 986: Chapter 5: The Greatest Opportunity of the Origin World (Please Subscribe)

Main Universe, Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his eyebrows slightly furrowed.

“Universal Catastrophe?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the combat between two Chaos Great Saints leading to the collapse of all universes within a vast area, prematurely entering Universal Catastrophe…

This kind of example…

He had indeed seen it in the records of the Demon Jade Space and the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.

The attacks of a Chaos Great Saint are capable of shattering all defensive barriers of a universe.

Even if they cannot completely erase this universe, they can still force its destruction, reverting it to its initial state.

For the universe itself, there are not many effects, for the universe still exists, but for the creatures within the universe, it is a disaster.

“If the Universal Catastrophe truly arrives early, what should I do?” Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

The Universal Catastrophe, in fact, also has little effect on Lin Yuan; with his strength, he can easily withstand the great destruction of the Catastrophe and enter the Chaos Void.

Even if he is unwilling to enter the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan can also rely on the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, hiding inside much like the Robber Clan, surviving until the next Cosmic Era.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, being semi-fused with the Origin Source, would not be affected by the Universal Catastrophe, making it nearly absolutely safe to hide inside, similar to the Robber Clan’s wooden hut.

Moreover, Lin Yuan can also traverse through the Myriad Realms Gate into other dimensional worlds, after stepping into the Second Layer, many restrictions of the Myriad Realms Gate were lifted for Lin Yuan, allowing his true self to descend upon any world.

This method is even more reliable than the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; as long as beings under the Thirteenth Layer do not act, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm remains in peace, but what if a Thirteenth Layer being takes action?

Of course, what kind of existence is a Thirteenth Layer being? The probability of them acting against the universe is nearly zero, but there is still such a possibility.

But the Myriad Realms Gate? Even for thirteenth-layer beings, it is very difficult to explore the worlds of other dimensional levels.

If the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is nearly absolutely safe, then through the Myriad Realms Gate, it is absolutely safe.

…

In short… Lin Yuan’s method of solving the Universal Catastrophe is too simple; for other beings, it is a catastrophe, even for the twelfth-layer ultimate beings.

But in Lin Yuan’s heart, it is not a concern at all.

However, even though Lin Yuan himself might not have a problem, countless citizens of human civilization would probably have to make a choice.

“This matter needs to be communicated to Xuanyuan and Xia Qin.” Lin Yuan quickly began contacting the other nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

In matters concerning the survival of the entire human civilization, the nine Supreme Beings also have the right to know.

A moment later.

Virtual World.

On the ten thrones, figures appeared one after another.

“Galaxy, what’s the matter calling us here?”

“What you’re saying, must there be a matter to summon us?”

“Indeed, we could also gather and chat from time to time.”

…

The nine Supreme Beings of human civilization were unusually relaxed; now that the entire universe had become the territory of human civilization, they, as Supreme Beings, are naturally very relaxed.

In the past, there was the threat of the twelfth-layer ultimate beings from the other eleven peak clan powers, the nine human Supreme Beings, while not walking on thin ice, felt a lot of pressure.

But now?

The Robber Clan adopted a policy of self-preservation, and the ultimate beings from the other top ten peak clans were suppressed, with their clan entities also being integrated into human civilization.

The human civilization of today is definitely the most prosperous ever; seeing this, their Supreme Beings naturally felt very content.

Lin Yuan, looking at the nine human Supreme Beings, pondered for a moment, and then said, “I have long since dispatched an avatar to explore the Chaos Void…”

The nine Supreme Beings immediately started listening attentively.

Ordinary twelfth-layer Path Splitting Realm powerhouses, their avatars, simply cannot stray too far from the universe.

But Lin Yuan?

The miracles created by Lin Yuan were just too many.

Thus, when the nine Supreme Beings learned that Lin Yuan had already begun exploring the Chaos Void outside the universe, not a single one was surprised.

However.

What followed.

The words spoken by Lin Yuan caused all the Supreme Beings’ faces to change color.

“What?”

“You mean to say our universe is about to be enveloped in the combat of two Chaos Great Saints, stepping prematurely into Universal Catastrophe?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s face was full of shock; he didn’t even know what a Chaos Great Saint represented.

But he understood very clearly the meaning of Universal Catastrophe.

The rest of the eight Supreme Beings felt similarly, the universe stepping prematurely into Catastrophe was a disaster for all twelfth-layer beings within the universe.

“Galaxy Master, are you sure this is true?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being earnestly inquired; Universal Catastrophe was not something to take lightly, it was related to their future and the entire human civilization.

“I’m ninety percent certain.” Lin Yuan nodded, the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent started a long voyage to avoid the combat zone of the two Chaos Great Saints; considering the mass of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, how vast an amount of chaos stones would be needed for its movement?

The Ancient Ming Venerable, daring to make such a move, must have received precise information.

“Ninety percent certain?”

The hearts of the Supreme Beings present thumped.

Ninety percent certainty practically assured that this event would happen.

“When roughly will the combat of the two Chaos Great Saints affect us?” Xuanyuan Supreme inquired.

“Between a hundred to a thousand years.” Lin Yuan answered.

According to the red region marked by the silver-haired woman on the map, the position of their home universe was directly in the trajectory of the two Chaos Great Saints’ battle zone, and it would be one of the first areas to be affected.

Time in the Chaos Void might be in a few years, but the flow of time within the universe is much faster, approximately within a century or a millennium.
